predecessors.name: Qing dynasty
predecessors.text: the Ili valley: 'This was the temporary end, for the time being, of Qing rule in the Ili Valley' (DR)

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: 'In 1871, Russia occupied the Ili territory' (TSP), returned to China except the area west of the new border by the treaty of 24 February 1881 and the evacuation of March 1883

ledger.x: 1864: the Dungans and Taranchis rise in the Ili valley.
1866: Qing rule in the Ili valley ends.

wars.name: Russian occupation of Ili
wars.outcome: Russia occupied the Ili territory in 1871, kept the Tekes valley under the failed Treaty of Livadia (September 1879), returned most of it by the Treaty of Saint Petersburg of 24 February 1881 (Russia kept the area west of the new Ili border) and left in March…

certainty.note: A rebel valley with no surveyed frontier.
